checkpoints.cargo_manifest:
[package]
name = "sts-sim"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT"
description = "Rust port of the v0.111.0 STS2 combat simulator (#1282)"

[features]
default = []
allocation-counting = []

[lib]
name = "sts_sim"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "sts-sim"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
rust_decimal = { version = "1.38", default-features = false, features = ["serde"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1.0", features = ["arbitrary_precision"] }
sha2 = "0.10"

# Benchmarks ship from release builds, so pin the codegen settings here rather
# than leaving them to whatever profile a caller happens to use (PORT_PLAN §2).
# dev/test stay on cargo defaults for compile speed.
[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
# The shipped CLI exposes typed refusals and never catches a panic.  Keeping
# unwinding in this large binary only retains landing pads/unwind metadata in
# the measured release image; dev/test keep Cargo's unwinding default for the
# invariant tests that deliberately use `catch_unwind`.
panic = "abort"

checkpoints.cargo_manifest:
[package]
name = "sts-sim"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT"
description = "Rust port of the v0.111.0 STS2 combat simulator (#1282)"

[features]
default = []
allocation-counting = []

[lib]
name = "sts_sim"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "sts-sim"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
rust_decimal = { version = "1.38", default-features = false, features = ["serde"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1.0", features = ["arbitrary_precision"] }
sha2 = "0.10"

# Benchmarks ship from release builds, so pin the codegen settings here rather
# than leaving them to whatever profile a caller happens to use (PORT_PLAN §2).
# dev/test stay on cargo defaults for compile speed.
[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
# The shipped CLI exposes typed refusals and never catches a panic.  Keeping
# unwinding in this large binary only retains landing pads/unwind metadata in
# the measured release image; dev/test keep Cargo's unwinding default for the
# invariant tests that deliberately use `catch_unwind`.
panic = "abort"
